title: Marnie's Super Tidy Boat
markdown:
WHOOSH! The canal sparkled like spilled diamonds! Sunshine BOUNCED off Marnie the cat's blue boat. Saturday! A day for zoomies! Marnie loved order. Super order! Her boat gleamed. Ropes coiled tight. Knobs sparkled. "Everyone knows the rules!" she purred.

"Whoooo is this bright kitty?" hooted Barnaby the Owl. "Ready to dash?"

Marnie blinked. "Good morning, Barnaby! Yes! My friends are coming. I want everything perfectly tidy!"

*ZIP!* Jules the mouse zoomed past. "Morning, Marnie!"

*BOOM!* Captain Ash stomped aboard. "Ahoy, Marnie! Ready for adventure?"

"Welcome aboard!" Marnie purred. "Just a moment!" She GRABBED her paints. *SWISH! BANG!* She DIPPED and PAINTED signs: "CUPBOARD: TEAS ONLY." "DRAWER: BISCUITS & JAM." And for a rope: "ROPE: MOORING USE ONLY."

"Amazing signs, Marnie!" Captain Ash boomed.

Jules twitched his whiskers. "Teas only? But what about a biscuit?"

"Biscuits are in the *Biscuit Drawer*," Marnie explained.

More signs POPPED up! The boat became a wonderland of rules!

Captain Ash wanted tea. He found it! Then biscuits. He opened the drawer. *Dig, dig, dig!* Biscuits were at the bottom! "Blast and barnacles!" he grumbled.

Jules wanted a cushion. He tugged the blanket box. *FLUMP!* Blankets were stuffed in tight! "Oh dear," he squeaked.

Suddenly! A gust of wind SHOVED the boat! *WHOOSH!* "The mooring rope! We need it NOW!" bellowed Captain Ash. He DARTED to the sign. "ROPE: MOORING USE ONLY!" he read. He GRABBED it. Stuck! Jules PULLED. Barnaby HOOTED. *HEAVE!* With a mighty GRUNT, the rope SNAPPED free! The boat nudged safely back. Phew!

Captain Ash wiped his brow. "Your signs are precise, Marnie. But maybe... a bit *too* precise for a jolly day?"

Marnie looked at her friends. Jules looked worried. Captain Ash looked flustered. Her super-tidy boat felt... not so happy.

"You're right," Marnie purred softly. "Perfect means happy and easy too!" A brilliant idea SPARKED!

"Let's make a new system!" she declared. "Teas live here. Biscuits love jam over there! Cushions and blankets can rest together!"

Jules bounced! Captain Ash laughed! "Fantastic, Marnie! Order with jolly freedom!"

They rearranged. Tea still lived in its cupboard, but a biscuit was okay too. Blankets and cushions shared their box, cozy and warm. The rope was still tidy, but easy to grab.

The boat sparkled, cheerful and warm. Tidy, yes, but full of happy possibility!

"Today," Marnie declared, tail flicking proudly, "is going to be AMAZING!"

And with a happy purr, Marnie, Jules, and Captain Ash sailed down the canal, ready for a wonderful weekend!
characters: Marnie the cat, Jules the mouse, Captain Ash
